library.fixEditor.launchExecutableHint: A file name picked from the game folder. A fix never carries a path.
library.fixEditor.executableNoFolder: The game folder was not found, so the name is typed by hand.
library.fixEditor.componentsHint: winetricks verbs separated by spaces. They are installed into the prefix when the fix is applied.
library.fixEditor.noAssemblies: None. Add one only when a mod needs a .dll the game does not ship.
library.fixEditor.assembliesHint: Taken from the Proton runtime's wine-mono and copied into a folder inside the game. A fix carries no files of its own.
library.fixEditor.noInputs: None. Add one when a value belongs to the player rather than to the fix — a name, this machine's address.
library.fixEditor.inputsHint: Write {{id}} in the launch arguments where the value goes. The launcher asks for it when the fix is applied, so nobody has to edit the arguments by hand.
library.fixEditor.downloadsCaution: These land in folders whose programs run on the machine of whoever applies the fix. They are shown the host and the checksum, and have to agree before anything is fetched.
library.fixEditor.noDownloads: None. Add one only when the mod itself has to come from somewhere — settings alone cannot install it.
library.fixEditor.downloadsHint: https only, pointing at a .zip, .7z or .rar, pinned by sha256 — run `sha256sum` on the file you tested. A link that serves whatever is newest cannot be pinned, and is refused.
library.fixEditor.notesHint: Anything the person applying it should know. Up to 12 lines.

library.fixEditor.problem.component: "{name}" is not a plain winetricks verb.

library.fixEditor.problem.downloadLabel: Every file needs a label saying what it is.

library.fixEditor.problem.downloadSha: "{label}" must pin a sha256 (64 hex characters).
library.fixEditor.problem.downloadInstal: Every file needs at least one destination.
library.fixEditor.problem.downloadFrom: "{path}" must be a folder inside the archive.
library.fixEditor.problem.downloadInto: "{path}" must start with "game:" or "prefix:" and stay inside it.
